corrections.reason: The numeral is ፲ (10 kinds of baptism, divided on the next line into ፮/6 symbolic and ፬/4 true baptisms), misread as ፳.
The ten baptisms are divided into ፮ቱ ምሳሌ (6 symbolic) and ፬ቱ አማናዊ (4 true, listed in lines 10-14); both numerals were misread as ፲ቱ.
Ge'ez 'በማየ አይኅ' (by the water of the flood) is printed with ኅ.
Clearly printed 'አራቱ' ('the four [true baptisms]: the Lord's baptism, tears of repentance, blood of martyrs, sea of fire'), misread as 'ኦሪቱ'.
Andemta contrast 'የኦሪትን መፍረሻ የወንጌልን መታነጺ' (the tearing down of the Orit and the building up [መታነጺ] of the Gospel); ጺ was misread as ሚ.
The Ge'ez/Amharic construct 'አባለ ዘሩን' (his generative organ) is printed with 1st-order አ and 1st-order ለ.
Purposive 'ሊያሳልፋቸው መጥቷል' (He has come to abolish them, introducing Matt 5:17), where ሊ was misread as ሲ.
